text: Create a box with a length of 32.0, a width of 81.0, and a height of 29.5. Apply a chamfer of 1.1 to all edges of the top face. Drill a hole with a diameter of 6.8 through the center of the top face. Drill a hole with a diameter of 7.8 through the center of the positive X face.

Create a cylinder with a height of 29.6 units and a radius of 22.7 units. On the top face, extrude a circle with a radius of 12.7 units by 3.4 units. On the top face of this new extrusion, extrude a circle with a radius of 8.0 units by 9.0 units.

Create a cylinder with a radius of 16.4 and a height of 36.0. Chamfer the top edge of the cylinder with a size of 1.9. On the top face, extrude a circular boss with a radius of 15.8 and a height of 4.9. Chamfer the top edge of the extruded boss with a size of 1.3.

Create a box with length 31.8, width 32.6, and height 10.5. Apply a fillet of radius 2.4 to all vertical edges. On the top face, cut a rectangular pocket with length 18.2 and width 12.1 to a depth of 5.1. On the top face, cut another rectangular pocket with length 7.8 and width 7.0 to a depth of 3.4. On the top face, cut a third rectangular pocket with length 11.4 and width 9.9 to a depth of 2.7.
Create a box with a length of 90.5, a width of 38.5, and a height of 31.5. Apply a fillet of radius 1.5 to all edges parallel to the Z-axis.
Create a box with a length of 78.1, a width of 51.8, and a height of 36.7. Apply a fillet of radius 1.9 to all edges parallel to the Z-axis.

Create a cylinder with a height of 25.7 and a radius of 18.6.
Apply a chamfer of 1.8 to the top circular edge.
Apply a chamfer of 1.5 to the new top circular edge.

Create a box with dimensions 94.9 long, 36.7 wide, and 21.5 high.
On the top face, extrude a circular boss with a radius of 10.4 by 4.6.
Apply a fillet of radius 2.3 to all vertical edges.
On the face in the positive X direction, drill a hole with a diameter of 11.6.
On the top face, extrude another circular boss with a radius of 10.7 by 7.3.
Create a cylinder with a radius of 25.2 and a height of 31.2.

Create a cylinder with a height of 36.0 and a radius of 25.1.
On its top face, drill a through hole with a diameter of 13.6.
From the top face of the cylinder, extrude a circle of radius 11.5 upwards by 4.1.
On the top face of this new extrusion, extrude a circle of radius 6.0 upwards by 7.8.

Create a box with a length of 49.6, a width of 44.7, and a height of 14.1.
Apply a fillet with a radius of 2.7 to all edges parallel to the Z-axis.
On the top face, create a workplane. Draw a circle with a radius of 9.1 and extrude it positively by 5.6.
On the top face of the extruded feature, drill a hole with a diameter of 7.8.

Create a cylinder with a radius of 50.0 and a height of 35.0.
On the top face, draw a circle with a radius of 16.0. Extrude this circle by 8.7 to create a boss.
Chamfer the top edges of this boss by 1.1.
From the top face of the boss, drill a through-hole with a diameter of 17.4.
From the top face of the boss, drill a through-hole with a diameter of 27.2.

Create a base box with a length of 89.0, a width of 55.2, and a height of 36.5. Drill a 4.6 diameter hole into the top face. Drill an 8.8 diameter hole into the positive X face. On the top face, draw a circle with a radius of 10.3 and extrude it by 3.7. Apply a fillet with a radius of 2.6 to all edges parallel to the Z-axis.

Create a box with X dimension 92.5, Y dimension 55.3, and Z dimension 16.2.
On the top face, extrude a circular boss from a circle with radius 14.8, to a height of 6.5.
On the top face of this boss, cut a rectangular pocket with X dimension 54.3 and Y dimension 26.8, to a depth of 5.5.
On the top face of this boss (around the previous cut), cut another rectangular pocket with X dimension 19.9 and Y dimension 6.9, to a depth of 5.8.
Create a rectangular box with length 81.1, width 69.7, and height 29.6. Apply a chamfer of 1.4 to all edges of the top face.

Create a rectangular box with length 49.2, width 57.5, and height 15.4. On its top face, drill a through hole with a diameter of 11.2. Chamfer all edges of the top face with a size of 1.6. Chamfer all edges of the top face with a size of 1.3. On the top face, extrude a circular boss with a radius of 13.8 to a height of 3.8.

Create a cylinder with a height of 39.8 and a radius of 28.2. Drill a 21.0 diameter through-hole from the top face. Subsequently, from the same top annular face, a 18.2 diameter through-hole is specified, which has no geometric effect. A further 11.0 diameter through-hole is specified from the top annular face, also without geometric effect.
Create a box with a length of 33.9, a width of 83.6, and a height of 21.6. On the top face (>Z), create a rectangular pocket with dimensions 8.5 by 28.3, cut to a depth of 9.9.
Create a box with length 96.2, width 43.9, and height 26.3. Apply a fillet of radius 1.9 to all edges parallel to the Z-axis.

Create a cylinder with a height of 43.6 and a radius of 36.1.
Drill a through hole with a diameter of 19.0, centered on the top face.
Extrude a circular boss with a radius of 10.7 from the top face, to a height of 2.9.

Create a cylinder with a radius of 10.1mm and a height of 19.1mm.
From the top face, drill a stepped through-hole: an outer counterbore with a diameter of 14.6mm and a depth of 19.1mm, and an inner concentric through-hole with a diameter of 11.0mm.
Apply a chamfer of 1.1mm to all edges on the top face of the part.
